sections.title: S1: WARM UP
sections.description:
Warm up 

a. Dynamic stretches
1 round of:
60/60 sec Dynamic Pec Stretch
60/60 sec Dynamic Lat Stretch
10/10/10 Wrist leans (forward, side to side, backward)

b. Metabolic prep
4 minutes Row performed as 40 sec Easy / 20 sec Hard

c. Activation
25 Banded Pull aparts
25 Banded Tricep extensions
25 Banded Bicep curls
25 Banded Delt raises
25 Banded Face pulls

d. Ring Muscle ups and Wall walks prep
Self directed or use below as guideline:
5 Inchworm push ups
20 sec Top of Ring dip hold
20 sec Bottom of Ring dip hold
10 Kip swings in high rings
20 sec Handstand hold (chest to wall)
+ 5 minutes to practice full Ring Muscle ups, Toes to rings, Wall walks and HR Push ups.

sections.title: S1: RELATIVE STRENGTH ENDURANCE (GYM.)
sections.description:
(Relative) Strength Endurance / Gymnastics

Elite:
a. 16 min EMOM (4 rounds)
1: 10 Toes to rings + Max Ring Muscle ups in the remaining time
2: Rest
3: 10 Hand release Push ups + Max Wall Walks in the remaining time
4: Rest

RX:
a. 16 min EMOM (4 rounds)
1: 8 Toes to rings + Max Ring Muscle ups in the remaining time
2: Rest
3: 8 Hand release Push ups + Max Wall Walks in the remaining time
4: Rest

Intermediate:
a. 16 min EMOM (4 rounds)
1: Ring Muscle ups / From box
2: Wall Walks / Reduced distance 
2: Toes to rings
4: Hand release Push ups
*Pick a sustainable number of reps on each station to complete with high quality.

Scaled:
a. Spend 20 minutes practicing your Ring Muscle ups. Use attached progressions.
----------------------------------

sections.title: S1: (OPTIONAL) CONDITIONING
sections.description:
(Optional) Conditioning,  “Lifting the roof” (V02 max │ 90+% Effort │ Severe-Extreme intensity domain │ Z4-5)

a. 10 min EMOM
Min 1: 20, 18, 16, 14, 12 Cal Row  (♀ 16, 14, 12, 10, 8)
+ Max burpees lateral over the rower in the remaining time
Min 2: Rest

Score: Total Burpees accumulated

Flow explained:
Minute 1: 20/16 Cal Row + Max burpees over rower
Minute 2: Rest
Minute 3: 18/14 Cal Row + Max burpees over rower
Minute 4: Rest
Minute 5: 16/12 Cal Row + Max burpees over rower
Minute 6: Rest
Minute 7: 14/10 Cal Row + Max burpees over rower
Minute 8: Rest
Minute 9: 12/8 Cal Row + Max burpees over rower
Minute 10: Rest

sections.title: S1: (TEAM VERSION) CONDITIONING
sections.description:
Note: One of the reasons most of us fall in love with CrossFit is the community aspect.
It’s being surrounded by others whom are like minded in an environment that brings out the best in us.
Pushing hard in training with a group can for some feel more enjoyable and can often give that extra kick needed to perform better.
The "Team Edition" add-ons to the program is for those who wishes to do team competitions now and in the future.
This will give those of you who might consider going team a structured session that will be based around synchro coordination, team workouts, relays & worm specific training. All elements that are key in creating a successful team.

It can be hard to coordinate training with 3 others and the program is therefore build in a way that the team session fits in with the rest of the weekly program, so that we make sure you hit everything you need to weekly.

This piece is to be done instead of the original engine piece.
_________________________________________
Conditioning

a. Online Semi-finals workout #3
As many reps as possible in 20 minutes of:
10 synchro alternating dumbbell snatches
15 synchro toes-to-bars
50 synchro double-unders
*Three athletes synchro
♀ 50 lb (22.5 kg)
♂ 70 lb (32.5 kg) 

Explanation: https://games-assets.crossfit.com/s3fs-public/2026-06/CFG26%20SF%20TEAM%20Workout%203%20Scorecard_V4_feanxsj.pdf?LZD3akYi_btUi8bOALUrQs6lG8JYBGVp
